summary: Master the art of Key Account Management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools to foster client loyalty and growth.
lede: Key account management helps teams prioritize strategic customers and coordinate plans around their business outcomes. Designed for professionals who grow, retain, or govern important customer relationships, this training builds practical skills in account selection and segmentation, stakeholder mapping and opportunity qualification, and coordinated account planning with renewal-risk tracking.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for growing, retaining, governing, or reporting on strategically important customer relationships. prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if available for spreadsheet-based account scoring and dashboard exercises.
